title: Wack 100 Reacts to Tory Lanez, And August Alsina Incident, "August Alsina Gonna Use That In A New Civil Case"
htmlContent:
According to Billboard, Tory Lanez is under investigation by the Los Angeles prosecutor's office following allegations that the rapper attacked singer August Alsina after a concert in Chicago this weekend.

On Sunday, Alsina posted a photo of himself on Instagram in which he can be seen standing in an elevator with blood coming from his mouth. In the story, Alsina claims that Lanez physically assaulted him after he refused to shake his hand after a performance on Saturday night.

“We are aware of the allegations that the defendant attacked artist August Alsina and are investigating these claims,” said the Los Angeles District Attorney’s Office in a statement to Billboard. “The allegations are serious and will be thoroughly examined.”

In an interview with DJ Akademics on Sunday the Jerry Sprunger rapper in a clip posted to YouTube said, “Nothing happened. I don’t even know what this kid is talking about, brother,”

After being asked again if he was involved, Lanez continued, “No, hell no! I don’t know if he’s doing [this for] promo. I don’t know what that n*** is talking about, bruh.”

 

On Monday night, Wack 100 was on Clubhouse and was asked if he had heard about the incident between August Alsina and Tory Lanez.

Someone asked Wack could the incident with August Alsina hurt his current legal troubles.

"Hell no August Alsina gonna use that in a new civil case that's what the f*** about to happen," said Wack 100.

Wack later jokingly said, "August Alsina could get Will Smith to tell the truth about dropping that bag Tory in trouble. Nah I mean s*** where they was at a public place?"

Iggy Azalea keeps shutting down the Internet with trendy looks and viral videos.

The singer is currently on tour, and everybody is speaking, including Tory Lanez. The singer posted a series of pictures on Instagram while performing on stage. In clips, Iggy is rocking a short, tight body that shows his curved physique.

This is not the first time that fans caught Tory Lanez gushing on Iggy in her comments section. Both have even sparked rumors of meetings for a while, but neither has yet confirmed them. Tory jumped at her comments, simply commenting on some purple emoji, including a purple heart. Iggy responded with a green heart emoji.

While neither Iggy nor Tory confirmed their alleged relationship, Tory was seen swinging Iggy's face on her t-shirt in a recent performance.
